baseline.note: Product cells cite E330 (6.1.4 upgrade audit) where its matrix names the boundary; other product cells cite their latest 6.0.6 record. Offline tools use Checked offline.

verbs.read: Return the current state of the object without a change.
verbs.write: Change an existing object's state or properties in place.
verbs.create: Make a new object where none existed.
verbs.move-or-copy: Relocate or duplicate an existing object with its state, including state that cannot be read.
verbs.revert: Reverse a recorded Ghostnote change of this row through its change record.
verbs.persist: The change survives a project save and reload.

statuses.Product: A named tool in the normal profile supplies the cell; its limits still apply.
statuses.Component: Code exists below the public surface; exposure and current-host proof can remain.
statuses.Research: A scoped experiment passed; general product behavior is not established.
statuses.Planned: An implementation or survey plan exists; completion is not implied.
statuses.Candidate: A source or user task supports investigation; no session is selected.
statuses.Unresolved: Evidence is insufficient to claim a route or choose an implementation.

proofLevels.Live: An experiment record names the operation, host build, result, and limits.
proofLevels.Checked offline: A check ran locally without a Bitwig connection during an audit or review.
proofLevels.Source: An implemented path was inspected in pinned source; it was not run here.
proofLevels.Claim: A README, listing, or release statement only.
proofLevels.Not found: No corresponding path was found in the inspected scope; this does not prove absence.

effortDrivers.extend-scalar-contract: Extend an existing public scalar contract: target and domain proof, observers, readback, reversal.
effortDrivers.expose-component: Expose an existing component: public contract, profile wiring, current-provider checks, failure isolation.
effortDrivers.offline-representation: Add an offline representation or index: corpus coverage, malformed input, resource identity, dependencies.
effortDrivers.internal-host-editing: Add internal host content editing: version discovery, identity, bounded commands, ownership, persistence, recovery.
effortDrivers.payload-families: Expand payload families: a different state format and behavior witness for each family.
effortDrivers.package-artifact: Package an accepted artifact: origin review, standalone closure, consumer tests, support and release terms.

cells.predicate: Matching extension build, an open project, a held track handle, and track and scene counts inside the window.
cells.counterexample: A target past the addressable window is invisible, not empty; health is outside-limit and other tools refuse.

cells.predicate: Lists every change this server process wrote with what each can and cannot put back; check_revert compares each place without a write.
cells.counterexample: An edit from before this connection or by a person is not listed; records do not survive a new server session.

cells.qualifier: fidelity exact, lossy, or none per change
cells.predicate: Writes only places that still hold what the change left; reports notRestored and removed; the reversal is its own change.
cells.counterexample: Device adds on one track must revert newest first or the call refuses; a removed device has redoFidelity none.

cells.predicate: Every addressable track with a durable trackId and kind, including children of collapsed groups.
cells.counterexample: coverage.status partial when the project has more tracks than the window; group tracks refuse clip tools with group-slot.

cells.predicate: readback.removed names each deleted trackId after the delete.

workRecords.title: Extend track state: arm, active state, colour
workRecords.sourceRoute: Gig Maestro TrackHandler setArm and setColor; existing mixer and track contracts
workRecords.requiredProof: Decide exposed fields. Prove each domain, automation behavior, selection effects, and guarded inverse. Name and four mixer fields already exist.

workRecords.title: Send discovery, level, enabled state, and pre/post mode
workRecords.sourceRoute: Gig Maestro SendHandler (send/setLevel, send/setMode AUTO/PRE/POST, send/setEnabled); DrivenByMoss LayerImpl
workRecords.requiredProof: Bind source send to destination identity. Test reordered sends, duplicate destination names, unavailable targets, automation, and independent readback. Measure units and observer cost.

workRecords.title: Master mixer
workRecords.sourceRoute: Gig Maestro MasterHandler; current track mixer refusal
workRecords.requiredProof: Decide a separate target contract. Prove Master identity under bank overflow and distinguish master fader control from audio capture.

workRecords.title: Transport: tempo, meter, position, play/stop, loop, metronome, recording
workRecords.sourceRoute: Gig Maestro TransportHandler; existing extension handles
workRecords.requiredProof: Inventory each verb separately. Separate transport effects from reversible scalar changes. Define stop and cleanup authority, concurrent playback changes, and readback. Meter needs its own source and host check.

workRecords.title: Cue markers: list, add, rename, position, colour
workRecords.sourceRoute: Control Deck handleCueMarkers (restores transport position); Gig Maestro ArrangerHandler
workRecords.requiredProof: Duplicate names and equal positions must stay distinguishable. Test sorting, capacity, concurrent edits, and transport restoration. Treat deletion as a separate directed operation.

workRecords.title: Scene names, colours, duplication, and launch controls
workRecords.sourceRoute: Gig Maestro SceneHandler; existing scene handlers
workRecords.requiredProof: Preserve row identity rules and clip references through insertion and deletion. Full scene content and automation fidelity need separate evidence.

workRecords.title: Effect, Group, and Hybrid creation, grouping, and routing
workRecords.qualifier: the add_tracks description overstates: E239 names createEffectTrack as not measured, not absent; group creation has typed-proxy and named-action evidence only
workRecords.sourceRoute: Gig Maestro track/createEffect (Application.createEffectTrack) and track/createGroup (Track.createParentTrack); Ghostnote E239 (effect route named, not measured), E16j (named action Create Group Track makes a group; D13 forbids named actions), E221 and the research handler branch.createParentTrack (parent handles return proxies; no route proof); existing add_tracks limits
workRecords.requiredProof: Measure Application.createEffectTrack on the current build first; if it makes an Effect track, correct the add_tracks description in that session. For groups, settle by readback whether createParentTrack creates a group or returns a proxy; the research handler exists. Do not use the named action as an identity-safe fallback (D13). Listing children does not prove membership edits.
workRecords.owner: Phase 10 feature matrix (track creation and group navigation rows)

workRecords.title: Global groove controls
workRecords.sourceRoute: Gig Maestro GrooveHandler
workRecords.requiredProof: Separate global shuffle and accent controls from editing note timing. Prove units, scope, enabled state, playback effect, and restoration.

workRecords.title: Launcher clip and track stop
workRecords.qualifier: distinct from transport stop (SM-4)
workRecords.sourceRoute: Gig Maestro clip/stop; openwig track.stop and slot.stop
workRecords.requiredProof: Define the stop target (slot, track, or all) and its readback (stopped or still queued). No change record applies, as for launch_clip. Check interaction with a person's concurrent launch.

workRecords.title: Track input and output routing
workRecords.qualifier: note-source input only in the pinned clones; no audio routing handler found
workRecords.sourceRoute: Gig Maestro track/addNoteSource and track/removeNoteSource; the Bitwig API source and destination selectors are not inspected here
workRecords.requiredProof: Survey the API routing objects on the current build first. Decide whether routing belongs to the product at all. Prove identity of routing targets by name collision tests before any write.

workRecords.title: Project save
workRecords.qualifier: action-based route only
workRecords.sourceRoute: openwig project.save through the GUI action Save; Ghostnote action evidence records focus hazards
workRecords.requiredProof: A named action is not an identity-safe route: prove that the saved file changed (hash before and after) and that focus did not redirect the action. Decide whether the operator keeps save authority, as current live-work rules assume.

workRecords.title: Extend note expression and timing fidelity
workRecords.sourceRoute: Existing document binding; DrivenByMoss CursorClipImpl; API evidence
workRecords.requiredProof: Split pressure, repeat, articulation, play range, finer timing, and overlaps. Prove each host field independently. Do not promise full MPE from channel support alone.

workRecords.title: Offline .bwclip import
workRecords.qualifier: heuristic extraction only
workRecords.sourceRoute: acidcat extraction and conversion; bwpreset codec as a structural reader candidate
workRecords.requiredProof: Compare multichannel, loop-offset, expression, empty, audio, and embedded-content fixtures with live reads. Reject ambiguous byte signatures and declare unsupported fields.

workRecords.title: Exact Arranger clip and note reads
workRecords.sourceRoute: openwig descriptor bridge and note reader; Ghostnote internal-access work
workRecords.requiredProof: Establish stable target identity, exact bounds, coverage, and missing-field reports on the current build. Start with read-only fixtures.

workRecords.title: Direct Arranger MIDI creation and editing
workRecords.sourceRoute: openwig _insertClip and _clipCreateAndFill
workRecords.requiredProof: Requires CA-3-quality identity and verification. Prove insertion, content, thread completion, persistence, partial failure, and scoped recovery.

workRecords.title: Direct Arranger audio insertion and editing
workRecords.sourceRoute: openwig _insertAudioClip
workRecords.requiredProof: Needs exact file identity, clip placement, source range, and saved and reloaded content. Stretch, warp, and destructive audio edits remain separate questions.

workRecords.title: Automation read and point/curve editing
workRecords.sourceRoute: openwig _insertAutomationPoints and graph readers
workRecords.requiredProof: Identify the owning parameter and time domain. Prove lane coverage, curve and hold interpolation, preservation, concurrent edits, and recovery. A scalar parameter setter is not automation authoring.

workRecords.title: Record Launcher playback into the Arranger
workRecords.sourceRoute: Control Deck active recording dispatch (handleRecordLauncherArrangement, 666 BPM)
workRecords.requiredProof: Decide whether performance recording is wanted as its own feature. Verify the resulting clips and timing. It does not replace CA-3 through CA-6.

workRecords.title: Launcher audio clip reads
workRecords.qualifier: no audio-clip content reader found in the pinned clones
workRecords.sourceRoute: None found. MA-2 covers insertion of a sample into an audio slot; this record covers reading an existing audio clip's file, range, and properties.
workRecords.requiredProof: Survey the API for audio clip properties on the current build. Decide whether file identity and range are observable at all through the controller API before planning a reader.

workRecords.title: Physical-unit parameter input
workRecords.sourceRoute: bwpreset units and descriptors; openwig normalization leads
workRecords.requiredProof: Each parameter needs an authoritative descriptor and timebase. Prove forward and inverse conversion, boundaries, discrete choices, and host display. Preserve refusal for other parameters.

workRecords.title: Remote-page creation and target assignment
workRecords.sourceRoute: bwpreset page and remote builders
workRecords.requiredProof: Separate reading and setting a control from creating its page. Prove page ownership, target paths, duplicate names, target deletion and reindexing, and persistence.

workRecords.title: Wider nested navigation, chain coverage, and device moves
workRecords.sourceRoute: Existing route guards; DrivenByMoss abstractions
workRecords.requiredProof: Name the blocked workflow first. Measure observer, bank, and traversal costs. Extend one route with exact owner and selection checks. No blanket arbitrary nesting claim.

workRecords.title: More container and slot types
workRecords.sourceRoute: bwpreset slot import; existing composer
workRecords.requiredProof: Define signal routing and preserve opaque device state. Test copied versus moved instances, automation, slot occupancy, and persistence.

workRecords.title: Preset and device discovery beyond explicit IDs and paths
workRecords.sourceRoute: acidcat library index; typed browser paths
workRecords.requiredProof: Separate offline search from live browser selection. Return exact identities. Confirm the inserted device independently. See MA-1 and MA-2 for file search and insertion.

workRecords.title: Export a device's current state as a preset file
workRecords.qualifier: action-based route only; no file verification
workRecords.sourceRoute: Control Deck bitwig_save_device_preset: selects the device in the editor, invokes the Save to Library action, then sends Enter after fixed sleeps; bwpreset authors files offline from definitions, not from a live device
workRecords.requiredProof: A named action is not an identity-safe route (D13; action evidence records focus hazards). Prove that a preset file appeared with the requested name and that its bytes load back to the same device state. Decide whether the operator keeps save authority, as current live-work rules assume. Check whether a typed API route exists on the current build before adopting the action.

workRecords.requiredProof: Preserve references, unknown supported fields, strings, metadata, and attachments. Bound bytes, collections, recursion, and objects. Compare real edits with goldens and the independent oracle before changing the live path.

workRecords.requiredProof: Edit only the identified route. Prove enabled and disabled behavior at top level and inside containers, with checkpoint and reversal.

workRecords.requiredProof: Validate explicit names, not an integer interval. Prove each admitted mode independently and preserve unrelated route state.

workRecords.title: Expand the admitted modulator catalog
workRecords.qualifier: by refusal family
workRecords.sourceRoute: E96 refusal families; MP-2 and MP-6 where relevant
workRecords.requiredProof: Select a refusal family and solve its actual cause. A new count or generated object does not remove page, trigger, or payload gates.

workRecords.title: Curves and envelope state
workRecords.sourceRoute: bwpreset curves and state
workRecords.requiredProof: Prove geometry, sustain, release, and loop markers, trigger behavior, preservation, and save and reload for each payload family.

workRecords.title: Wavetable, sample-player, and multisample state
workRecords.sourceRoute: bwpreset assets
workRecords.requiredProof: Prove resource identity, dependency metadata, zones, path resolution, opaque-state preservation, signal behavior, and persistence.

workRecords.title: Track, device, and hardware source bindings
workRecords.sourceRoute: bwpreset bindings
workRecords.requiredProof: Preserve selector meaning. An unavailable track or hardware port must not silently bind another source. Verify project and hardware changes.

workRecords.title: Product Grid reads, catalog, decimal/boolean values, cables, module add/delete, internal mapping add/remove
workRecords.qualifier: Phase 11 wave one; research proof on 6.1.4
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 11 wave one; GridGraphRead; doctor roles
workRecords.requiredProof: Normal-profile integration and the named remaining live checks. Every native symbol must be one of the 76 admitted doctor roles.

workRecords.title: Relocation, integer/indexed values, FX/Note writes, stateful attachment
workRecords.qualifier: Phase 11 wave two; relocation needs a new setter
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 11 wave two
workRecords.requiredProof: New setters or symbols where required, a batched doctor version, and per-family write proof. Relocation is the first wave-two item.

workRecords.title: Offline Grid preset generation and import
workRecords.sourceRoute: bwpreset Patch, codec, typed ports, fragments
workRecords.requiredProof: Define a deterministic graph representation. Prove file load, dependencies, values, cables, remotes, and persistence. Live editing does not produce this artifact automatically.

workRecords.title: Broader descriptor access for non-Grid objects
workRecords.sourceRoute: Existing Ghostnote read bridge and doctor; openwig patterns
workRecords.requiredProof: Choose one object and operation. Establish exact-build identity, bounded traversal, names and IDs, coverage, and independent interpretation. Do not assume Grid admission covers Arranger or outer modulators.

workRecords.title: Grid resources, array data, outer modulators, patches over 64 modules, DSP or audio guarantees
workRecords.qualifier: beyond the current Phase 11 plan
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 11 limits; selected research reads
workRecords.requiredProof: Each needs a separate scope and proof. A resource identity read is not a resource writer. No general sound-quality claim follows from graph readback.

workRecords.title: DSP decompilation and modified-image deployment
workRecords.qualifier: source lead only; loader acceptance unproved
workRecords.sourceRoute: Nitro tooling
workRecords.requiredProof: Parsing and decompilation exist. Modified-image loader acceptance is unproved in the pinned source. This is not an inexpensive route to normal control breadth.

workRecords.title: Indexed sample and preset discovery
workRecords.sourceRoute: acidcat library registry, search, metadata, and similarity
workRecords.requiredProof: Bounded search, canonical path, freshness, file identity, and missing-file reports. Avoid a full library scan on every call. Decide optional service versus local integration.

workRecords.title: Explicit sample insertion into Sampler or an audio slot
workRecords.sourceRoute: Control Deck insert_sample_file (handleInsertSampleFile); existing device guards
workRecords.requiredProof: Separate destinations. Check occupancy, source bytes, inserted device or clip, and sample identity. Test WAV, AIFF, and FLAC independently. Record effects before later verification can fail.

workRecords.title: Normal capture tool
workRecords.qualifier: historical live proof on 6.0.6; project master only
workRecords.sourceRoute: Ghostnote audio-capture module and E125
workRecords.requiredProof: Preserve recorder ownership, saved-project association, stable output identity, cleanup, cancellation, and scope. Prove the selected path on the current host.
workRecords.owner: Phase 7d/7e components; no exposure session selected

workRecords.title: Normal audio-facts tool
workRecords.qualifier: offline provider proof
workRecords.sourceRoute: Ghostnote audio-facts module and E124
workRecords.requiredProof: Preserve byte, range, and channel identity and provider failure isolation. Decide whether to retain or expand input formats. Analysis failure must not discard a successful capture.
workRecords.owner: Phase 7d/7e components; no exposure session selected

workRecords.title: Optional sample features, BPM/key, and similarity analysis
workRecords.sourceRoute: acidcat analysis
workRecords.requiredProof: Compare precise outputs, units, uncertainty, and provider cost. These features do not replace the existing loudness, crest, and silence contract.

workRecords.title: Harmonic, rhythmic, repeated-section, and arrangement navigation
workRecords.qualifier: 8i17 survey; no provider selected
workRecords.sourceRoute: 8i17; Music21, Partitura, midi-miner, jSymbolic, musif, Tonal leads
workRecords.requiredProof: Freeze real passage-finding tasks. Compare full notes, simple summaries, and musical analysis. Measure accuracy, ambiguity, tokens, calls, latency, and recovery.

workRecords.title: Stem separation and audio-to-MIDI transcription
workRecords.qualifier: no audited implementation donor in the pinned set
workRecords.sourceRoute: None audited; Superpowers release claims only
workRecords.requiredProof: A separate provider survey is needed if selected. These are analysis and transformation tasks, not automatically excluded as musical generation.

workRecords.title: Documentation and reference retrieval
workRecords.qualifier: deferred provider candidate
workRecords.sourceRoute: Workstation interface audit and Phase 10
workRecords.requiredProof: Exact-version sources, verified cache, provider isolation, and a demonstrated task need. Keep it separate from the normal host runtime.

workRecords.title: Release and upgrade live suite
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 10c
workRecords.requiredProof: E330 supplies a current upgrade run, not the complete reusable release policy. Reconcile its drivers and the route suite with 10c.

workRecords.title: Standalone bwmod package
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 10a
workRecords.requiredProof: Review every file's origin. No new editor in that session's scope. No runtime Python or host dependency in the selected package.

workRecords.title: Document 1.0 and benchmark publication package
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 10b
workRecords.requiredProof: Keep portable format, host binding, benchmark denominators, and reproduction separate. Review redistribution and exact candidate hashes.

workRecords.title: Retire stable-v1
workRecords.qualifier: backlog item
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 10 and E272
workRecords.requiredProof: Remove frozen-only paths after preserving migration records and checking current consumers. Do not delete conformance witnesses without replacements.

workRecords.title: Installation, cross-platform paths, extension packaging, and compatibility policy
workRecords.qualifier: backlog item; live evidence is macOS only
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 10
workRecords.requiredProof: Current live evidence is macOS. A portable API is not proof of Windows or Linux behavior.

workRecords.title: Correct contradicted working references
workRecords.qualifier: proposed bounded documentation session
workRecords.sourceRoute: Current format spec, parser comment, and later primary checks
workRecords.requiredProof: Narrow documentation correction only. Preserve historical E and D records and measured byte-surgery invariants.

workRecords.title: Publish the .bwpreset format working spec
workRecords.qualifier: Phase 10 publishable artifact without a brief
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 10 README, publishable artifacts; BWFORMAT_SPEC.md
workRecords.requiredProof: Apply DL-6 first so the published reading is current. Decide whether negative results and historical errors publish with it. Review redistribution of any embedded vendor facts.

workRecords.title: Publish the device and parameter-ID catalog
workRecords.qualifier: 10a excludes it; no origin or redistribution review exists
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 10 README, publishable artifacts; the catalog is generated from the application bundle
workRecords.requiredProof: The catalog derives from the installed application. Decide whether that derivation may be redistributed at all before any packaging work.

workRecords.title: Publish the extension itself
workRecords.qualifier: 10a excludes it; depends on daemon and surface stability
workRecords.sourceRoute: Phase 10 README, publishable artifacts
workRecords.requiredProof: Release and upgrade suite (DL-1) and installation and packaging policy (DL-5) come first. A stable description cohort and support terms are needed.
